name: 🛡️ Secure AI SaaS Helpdesk — Prompt Injection Defense & PII Redaction (SoterAI + OpenAI)

parameters.content:
## 🛡️ Secure AI SaaS Helpdesk — Prompt Injection Defense & PII Redaction

**AcmeCloud support chatbot that hardens every AI reply against prompt injection and leaks.** SoterAI screens each incoming message (blocking injection / off-topic attacks and redacting PII), the request is routed by intent to an OpenAI-powered agent, and every draft answer is re-scanned by SoterAI before it reaches the customer.

### How it works
1. **Input guard** — SoterAI inspects each chat message for prompt-injection or policy violations and redacts PII. Unsafe messages are logged and politely blocked.
2. **Redact & route** — the cleaned text is classified into *Bug report*, *Human handoff*, or *Knowledge-base question*.
3. **AI agents** — the matching OpenAI agent replies; the KB agent grounds answers in a Pinecone vector store using Cohere embeddings.
4. **Output guard** — SoterAI re-scans the draft reply and redacts anything unsafe before it is returned to the user.

### Setup
- Connect credentials: **SoterAI**, **OpenAI**, **Pinecone**, and **Cohere**.
- Select your Pinecone index and load your help-center docs into it.
- Tailor `allowedTopics` on the input guard and the agent prompts to your product.
- Publish the workflow, then open the built-in chat to test.

### Requirements
Accounts/API keys for SoterAI, OpenAI, Pinecone, and Cohere.

### Notes
- **SoterAI node:** always install and use the **latest version** of the SoterAI node (`n8n-nodes-soterai`) for the input & output guards.
- **LLM is swappable:** OpenAI is the default, but you can replace the *OpenAI Chat Model* node with **Groq** or **Anthropic** — just plug in the matching chat-model node and its credential; the rest of the workflow stays the same.

parameters.content:
## 1. Receive & guard input

The chat trigger receives the customer message. **SoterAI (input guard)** scans it for prompt-injection and policy violations and redacts PII before anything reaches the AI.

## 2. Block & log threats

When the guard flags a message as unsafe, the incident (session, verdict, risk score) is logged and the user gets a polite "blocked" reply — the message never reaches an agent.

## 3. Redact & route by intent

Safe text is standardized, then classified into one of three routes — **bug report**, **human handoff**, or **knowledge-base question** — and dispatched by the Switch.

## 4. AI agents answer

Each route has an OpenAI-powered agent: **Bug Analysis** triages severity and files a ticket, **Handoff** writes an empathetic escalation, and the **Knowledge Base** agent grounds answers in Pinecone (Cohere embeddings) before generating a reply.

The chat model, per-route memory buffers, the Pinecone vector store and the Cohere embeddings sit as sub-nodes below the agents.

## 5. Guard output & reply

**SoterAI (output guard)** re-scans the drafted answer and redacts anything unsafe, then the verified reply is returned to the customer.
